cittaṁ abhininnāmesiṁ.<br><br>So dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi—<br><br>‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṁ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā;<br><br>te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapannā.<br><br>Ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṁ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā;<br><br>te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā’ti.<br><br>Iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho me, brāhmaṇa, rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā vijjā adhigatā,<br><br>avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato, āloko uppanno—<br><br>yathā taṁ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho me, brāhmaṇa, dutiyābhinibbhidā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakasseva aṇḍakosamhā.<br><br>So evaṁ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṁ khayañāṇāya cittaṁ abhininnāmesiṁ.<br><br>So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ;<br><br>‘ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ āsavasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ āsavanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, ‘ayaṁ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ.<br><br>Tassa me evaṁ jānato evaṁ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṁ vimuccittha bhavāsavāpi cittaṁ vimuccittha avijjāsavāpi cittaṁ vimuccittha.<br><br>Vimuttasmiṁ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṁ ahosi.<br><br>‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ, kataṁ karaṇīyaṁ, nāparaṁ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsiṁ.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho me, brāhmaṇa, rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā,<br><br>avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato, āloko uppanno—<br><br>yathā taṁ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho me, brāhmaṇa, tatiyābhinibbhidā ahosi—kukkuṭacchāpakasseva aṇḍakosamhā”ti.<br><br>Evaṁ vutte, verañjo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“jeṭṭho bhavaṁ gotamo, seṭṭho bhavaṁ gotamo.<br><br>Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama.<br><br>Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṁ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṁ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṁ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṁ dhāreyya—‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti;<br><br>evamevaṁ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.<br><br>Esāhaṁ bhavantaṁ gotamaṁ saraṇaṁ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.<br><br>Upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gataṁ.<br><br>Adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṁ gotamo verañjāyaṁ vassāvāsaṁ saddhiṁ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.<br><br>Adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.<br><br>Atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṁ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā pakkāmi.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena verañjā dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṁ.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena uttarāpathakā assavāṇijā pañcamattehi assasatehi verañjaṁ vassāvāsaṁ upagatā honti.<br><br>Tehi assamaṇḍalikāsu bhikkhūnaṁ patthapatthapulakaṁ paññattaṁ hoti.<br><br>Bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya verañjaṁ piṇḍāya pavisitvā piṇḍaṁ alabhamānā assamaṇḍalikāsu piṇḍāya caritvā patthapatthapulakaṁ ārāmaṁ āharitvā udukkhale koṭṭetvā koṭṭetvā paribhuñjanti.<br><br>Āyasmā panānando patthapulakaṁ silāyaṁ pisitvā bhagavato upanāmeti. Taṁ bhagavā paribhuñjati.<br><br>Assosi kho bhagavā udukkhalasaddaṁ.<br><br>Jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti;<br><br>kālaṁ viditvā pucchanti, kālaṁ viditvā na pucchanti;<br><br>atthasaṁhitaṁ tathāgatā pucchanti, no anatthasaṁhitaṁ.<br><br>Anatthasaṁhite setughāto tathāgatānaṁ.<br><br>Dvīhi ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti— dhammaṁ vā desessāma, sāvakānaṁ vā sikkhāpadaṁ paññapessāmāti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ āmantesi—“kiṁ nu kho so, ānanda, udukkhalasaddo”ti?<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesi.<br><br>“Sādhu sādhu, ānanda.<br><br>Tumhehi, ānanda, sappurisehi vijitaṁ. Pacchimā janatā sālimaṁsodanaṁ atimaññissatī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“etarahi, bhante, verañjā dubbhikkhā dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā.<br><br>Na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṁ.<br><br>Imissā, bhante, mahāpathaviyā heṭṭhimatalaṁ sampannaṁ—seyyathāpi khuddamadhuṁ anīlakaṁ; evamassādaṁ.<br><br>Sādhāhaṁ, bhante, pathaviṁ parivatteyyaṁ. Bhikkhū pappaṭakojaṁ paribhuñjissantī”ti.<br><br>“Ye pana te, moggallāna, pathavinissitā pāṇā te kathaṁ karissasī”ti?<br><br>“Ekāhaṁ, bhante, pāṇiṁ abhinimminissāmi—seyyathāpi mahāpathavī. Ye pathavinissitā pāṇā te tattha saṅkāmessāmi.<br><br>Ekena hatthena pathaviṁ parivattessāmī”ti.<br><br>“Alaṁ, moggallāna, mā te rucci pathaviṁ parivattetuṁ.<br><br>Vipallāsampi sattā paṭilabheyyun”ti.<br><br>“Sādhu, bhante, sabbo bhikkhusaṅgho uttarakuruṁ piṇḍāya gaccheyyā”ti.<br><br>“Alaṁ, moggallāna, mā te rucci sabbassa bhikkhusaṅghassa uttarakuruṁ piṇḍāya gamanan”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi—<br><br>“katamesānaṁ kho buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosi;<br><br>katamesānaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti?<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idha mayhaṁ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi—<br><br>‘katamesānaṁ kho buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosi, katamesānaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī’ti. Katamesānaṁ nu kho, bhante, buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosi, katamesānaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti?<br><br>“Bhagavato ca, sāriputta, vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosi.<br><br>Bhagavato ca, sāriputta, kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti.<br><br>“Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena bhagavato ca vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti?<br><br>“Bhagavā ca, sāriputta, vipassī bhagavā ca sikhī bhagavā ca vessabhū kilāsuno ahesuṁ sāvakānaṁ vitthārena dhammaṁ desetuṁ.<br><br>Appakañca nesaṁ ahosi suttaṁ geyyaṁ veyyākaraṇaṁ gāthā udānaṁ itivuttakaṁ jātakaṁ abbhutadhammaṁ vedallaṁ.<br><br>Apaññattaṁ sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ. Anuddiṭṭhaṁ pātimokkhaṁ.<br><br>Tesaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṁ sāvakānaṁ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṁ brahmacariyaṁ khippaññeva antaradhāpesuṁ.<br><br>Seyyathāpi, sāriputta, nānāpupphāni phalake nikkhittāni suttena asaṅgahitāni tāni vāto vikirati vidhamati viddhaṁseti.<br><br>Taṁ kissa hetu?<br><br>Yathā taṁ suttena asaṅgahitattā.<br><br>Evameva kho, sāriputta, tesaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṁ sāvakānaṁ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṁ brahmacariyaṁ khippaññeva antaradhāpesuṁ.<br><br>Akilāsuno ca te bhagavanto ahesuṁ sāvake cetasā ceto paricca ovadituṁ.<br><br>Bhūtapubbaṁ, sāriputta, vessabhū bhagavā arahaṁ sammāsambuddho aññatarasmiṁ bhiṁsanake vanasaṇḍe sahassaṁ bhikkhusaṅghaṁ cetasā ceto paricca ovadati anusāsati—<br><br>‘evaṁ vitakketha, mā evaṁ vitakkayittha;<br><br>evaṁ manasikarotha, mā evaṁ manasākattha;<br><br>idaṁ pajahatha, idaṁ upasampajja viharathā’ti.<br><br>Atha kho, sāriputta, tassa bhikkhusahassassa vessabhunā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṁ ovadiyamānānaṁ evaṁ anusāsiyamānānaṁ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṁsu.<br><br>Tatra sudaṁ, sāriputta, bhiṁsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṁsanakatasmiṁ hoti—yo koci avītarāgo taṁ vanasaṇḍaṁ pavisati, yebhuyyena lomāni haṁsanti.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo yena bhagavato ca vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṁ na ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti.<br><br>“Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena bhagavato ca kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti?<br><br>“Bhagavā ca, sāriputta, kakusandho bhagavā ca koṇāgamano bhagavā ca kassapo akilāsuno ahesuṁ sāvakānaṁ vitthārena dhammaṁ desetuṁ.<br><br>Bahuñca nesaṁ ahosi suttaṁ geyyaṁ veyyākaraṇaṁ gāthā udānaṁ itivuttakaṁ jātakaṁ abbhutadhammaṁ vedallaṁ,<br><br>paññattaṁ sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ, uddiṭṭhaṁ pātimokkhaṁ.<br><br>Tesaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṁ sāvakānaṁ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṁ brahmacariyaṁ ciraṁ dīghamaddhānaṁ ṭhapesuṁ.<br><br>Seyyathāpi, sāriputta, nānāpupphāni phalake nikkhittāni suttena susaṅgahitāni, tāni vāto na vikirati na vidhamati na viddhaṁseti.<br><br>Taṁ kissa hetu?<br><br>Yathā taṁ suttena susaṅgahitattā.<br><br>Evameva kho, sāriputta, tesaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṁ sāvakānaṁ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṁ brahmacariyaṁ ciraṁ dīghamaddhānaṁ ṭhapesuṁ.<br><br>Ayaṁ kho, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo yena bhagavato ca kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṁ ciraṭṭhitikaṁ ahosī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṁsaṁ uttarāsaṅgaṁ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṁ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“etassa, bhagavā, kālo. Etassa, sugata, kālo.<br><br>Yaṁ bhagavā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeyya, uddiseyya pātimokkhaṁ, yathayidaṁ brahmacariyaṁ addhaniyaṁ assa ciraṭṭhitikan”ti.<br><br>“Āgamehi tvaṁ, sāriputta. Āgamehi tvaṁ, sāriputta.<br><br>Tathāgatova tattha kālaṁ jānissati.<br><br>Na tāva, sāriputta, satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ yāva na idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti. Yato ca kho, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ tesaṁyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭighātāya.<br><br>Na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho rattaññumahattaṁ patto hoti.<br><br>Yato ca kho, sāriputta, saṅgho rattaññumahattaṁ patto hoti atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ tesaṁyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭighātāya.<br><br>Na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho vepullamahattaṁ patto hoti.<br><br>Yato ca kho, sāriputta, saṅgho vepullamahattaṁ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ tesaṁyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭighātāya.<br><br>Na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho lābhaggamahattaṁ patto hoti.<br><br>Yato ca kho, sāriputta, saṅgho lābhaggamahattaṁ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ tesaṁyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭighātāya.<br><br>Na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho bāhusaccamahattaṁ patto hoti.<br><br>Yato ca kho, sāriputta, saṅgho bāhusaccamahattaṁ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapeti uddisati pātimokkhaṁ tesaṁyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭighātāya.<br><br>Nirabbudo hi, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho nirādīnavo apagatakāḷako suddho sāre patiṭṭhito.<br><br>Imesañhi, sāriputta, pañcannaṁ bhikkhusatānaṁ yo pacchimako bhikkhu so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ āmantesi—“āciṇṇaṁ kho panetaṁ, ānanda, tathāgatānaṁ yehi nimantitā vassaṁ vasanti, na te anapaloketvā janapadacārikaṁ pakkamanti.<br><br>Āyāmānanda, verañjaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ apalokessāmā”ti.<br><br>“Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.<br><br>Atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.<br><br>Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho verañjaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ bhagavā etadavoca—“nimantitamha tayā, brāhmaṇa, vassaṁvuṭṭhā, apalokema taṁ,<br><br>“icchāma mayaṁ janapadacārikaṁ pakkamitun”ti.<br><br>“Saccaṁ, bho gotama, nimantitattha mayā vassaṁvuṭṭhā; api ca yo deyyadhammo so na dinno.<br><br>Tañca kho no asantaṁ,<br><br>nopi adātukamyatā, taṁ kutettha labbhā bahukiccā gharāvāsā bahukaraṇīyā.<br><br>Adhivāsetu me bhavaṁ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṁ saddhiṁ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.<br><br>Adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā verañjaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṁsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.<br><br>Atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṁ khādanīyaṁ bhojanīyaṁ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṁ ārocāpesi—“kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṁ bhattan”ti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṁ bhikkhusaṅghena.<br><br>Atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo buddhappamukhaṁ bhikkhusaṅghaṁ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṁ bhuttāviṁ onītapattapāṇiṁ ticīvarena acchādesi, ekamekañca bhikkhuṁ ekamekena dussayugena acchādesi.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā verañjaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṁsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā verañjāyaṁ yathābhirantaṁ viharitvā anupagamma soreyyaṁ saṅkassaṁ kaṇṇakujjaṁ yena payāgapatiṭṭhānaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā payāgapatiṭṭhāne gaṅgaṁ nadiṁ uttaritvā yena bārāṇasī tadavasari.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṁ yathābhirantaṁ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṁ pakkāmi.<br><br>Anupubbena cārikaṁ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.<br><br>Tatra sudaṁ bhagavā vesāliyaṁ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyanti.<br><br>Verañjabhāṇavāro niṭṭhito.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena vesāliyā avidūre kalandagāmo nāma atthi. Tattha sudinno nāma kalandaputto seṭṭhiputto hoti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto sambahulehi sahāyakehi saddhiṁ vesāliṁ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṁ desento nisinno hoti.<br><br>Addasa kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavantaṁ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṁ dhammaṁ desentaṁ nisinnaṁ. Disvānassa etadahosi—“yannūnāhampi dhammaṁ suṇeyyan”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto yena sā parisā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.<br><br>Ekamantaṁ nisinnassa kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa etadahosi—<br><br>“yathā yathā kho ahaṁ bhagavatā dhammaṁ desitaṁ ājānāmi, nayidaṁ sukaraṁ agāraṁ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṁ ekantaparisuddhaṁ saṅkhalikhitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ;<br><br>yannūnāhaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajeyyan”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sā parisā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṁsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā pakkāmi.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto aciravuṭṭhitāya parisāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“yathā yathāhaṁ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṁ desitaṁ ājānāmi, nayidaṁ sukaraṁ agāraṁ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṁ ekantaparisuddhaṁ saṅkhalikhitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ;<br><br>icchāmahaṁ, bhante, kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajituṁ.<br><br>Pabbājetu maṁ bhagavā”ti.<br><br>“Anuññātosi pana tvaṁ, sudinna, mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti?<br><br>“Na kho ahaṁ, bhante, anuññāto mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>“Na kho, sudinna, tathāgatā ananuññātaṁ mātāpitūhi puttaṁ pabbājentī”ti.<br><br>“Sohaṁ, bhante, tathā karissāmi yathā maṁ mātāpitaro anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto vesāliyaṁ taṁ karaṇīyaṁ tīretvā yena kalandagāmo yena mātāpitaro tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā mātāpitaro etadavoca—<br><br>“ammatātā, yathā yathāhaṁ bhagavatā dhammaṁ desitaṁ ājānāmi, nayidaṁ sukaraṁ agāraṁ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṁ ekantaparisuddhaṁ saṅkhalikhitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ;<br><br>icchāmahaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajituṁ.<br><br>Anujānātha maṁ agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Evaṁ vutte, sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, tāta sudinna, amhākaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato. Na tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi mayaṁ te akāmakā vinā bhavissāma<br><br>kiṁ pana mayaṁ taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho sudinno kalandaputto mātāpitaro etadavoca—<br><br>“ammatātā, yathā yathāhaṁ bhagavatā dhammaṁ desitaṁ ājānāmi, nayidaṁ sukaraṁ agāraṁ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṁ ekantaparisuddhaṁ saṅkhalikhitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ;<br><br>icchāmahaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajituṁ.<br><br>Anujānātha maṁ agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, tāta sudinna, amhākaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato.<br><br>Na tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi mayaṁ te akāmakā vinā bhavissāma,<br><br>kiṁ pana mayaṁ taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Tatiyampi kho sudinno kalandaputto mātāpitaro etadavoca—<br><br>“ammatātā, yathā yathāhaṁ bhagavatā dhammaṁ desitaṁ ājānāmi, nayidaṁ sukaraṁ agāraṁ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṁ ekantaparisuddhaṁ saṅkhalikhitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ;<br><br>icchāmahaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajituṁ.<br><br>Anujānātha maṁ agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Tatiyampi kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, tāta sudinna, amhākaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato.<br><br>Na tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi mayaṁ te akāmakā vinā bhavissāma,<br><br>kiṁ pana mayaṁ taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto—“na maṁ mātāpitaro anujānanti agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti,<br><br>tattheva anantarahitāya bhūmiyā nipajji—<br><br>“idheva me maraṇaṁ bhavissati pabbajjā vā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto ekampi bhattaṁ na bhuñji, dvepi bhattāni na bhuñji, tīṇipi bhattāni na bhuñji, cattāripi bhattāni na bhuñji, pañcapi bhattāni na bhuñji, chapi bhattāni na bhuñji, sattapi bhattāni na bhuñji.<br><br>Atha kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—“tvaṁ khosi, tāta sudinna, amhākaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato.<br><br>Na tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi mayaṁ te akāmakā vinā bhavissāma,<br><br>kiṁ pana mayaṁ taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya?<br><br>Uṭṭhehi, tāta sudinna, bhuñja ca piva ca paricārehi ca,<br><br>bhuñjanto pivanto paricārento kāme paribhuñjanto puññāni karonto abhiramassu.<br><br>Na taṁ mayaṁ anujānāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Evaṁ vutte, sudinno kalandaputto tuṇhī ahosi.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, tāta sudinna, amhākaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato.<br><br>Na tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi mayaṁ te akāmakā vinā bhavissāma,<br><br>kiṁ pana mayaṁ taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya.<br><br>Uṭṭhehi, tāta sudinna, bhuñja ca piva ca paricārehi ca,<br><br>bhuñjanto pivanto paricārento kāme paribhuñjanto puññāni karonto abhiramassu.<br><br>Na taṁ mayaṁ anujānāma agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Tatiyampi kho sudinno kalandaputto tuṇhī ahosi.<br><br>Atha kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa sahāyakā yena sudinno kalandaputto tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, samma sudinna, mātāpitūnaṁ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukhedhito sukhaparihato.<br><br>Na tvaṁ, samma sudinna, kiñci dukkhassa jānāsi.<br><br>Maraṇenapi te mātāpitaro akāmakā vinā bhavissanti,<br><br>kiṁ pana taṁ jīvantaṁ anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajāya.<br><br>Uṭṭhehi, samma sudinna, bhuñja ca piva ca paricārehi ca,<br><br>bhuñjanto pivanto paricārento kāme paribhuñjanto puññāni karonto abhiramassu,<br><br>na taṁ mātāpitaro anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Evaṁ vutte, sudinno kalandaputto tuṇhī ahosi.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa sahāyakā sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“tvaṁ khosi, samma sudinna …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho sudinno kalandaputto tuṇhī ahosi.<br><br>Atha kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa sahāyakā yena sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā sudinnassa kalandaputtassa mātāpitaro etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“ammatātā, eso sudinno anantarahitāya bhūmiyā nipanno—<br><br>‘idheva me maraṇaṁ bhavissati pabbajjā vā’ti.<br><br>Sace tumhe sudinnaṁ nānujānissatha agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya, tattheva maraṇaṁ āgamissati.<br><br>Sace pana tumhe sudinnaṁ anujānissatha agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya, pabbajitampi naṁ dakkhissatha.<br><br>Sace sudinno nābhiramissati agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya, kā tassa aññā gati bhavissati, idheva paccāgamissati.<br><br>Anujānātha sudinnaṁ agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>“Anujānāma, tātā, sudinnaṁ agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa sahāyakā yena sudinno kalandaputto tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā sudinnaṁ kalandaputtaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“uṭṭhehi, samma sudinna, anuññātosi mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto—“anuññātomhi kira mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāyā”ti, haṭṭho udaggo pāṇinā gattāni paripuñchanto vuṭṭhāsi.<br><br>Atha kho sudinno kalandaputto katipāhaṁ balaṁ gāhetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“anuññāto ahaṁ, bhante, mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajjāya.<br><br>Pabbājetu maṁ bhagavā”ti.<br><br>Alattha kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavato santike pabbajjaṁ, alattha upasampadaṁ.<br><br>Acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā sudinno evarūpe dhutaguṇe samādāya vattati, āraññiko hoti piṇḍapātiko paṁsukūliko sapadānacāriko,<br><br>aññataraṁ vajjigāmaṁ upanissāya viharati.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena vajjī dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā, na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa etadahosi—“etarahi kho vajjī dubbhikkhā dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā, na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṁ.<br><br>Bahū kho pana me vesāliyaṁ ñātī aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavittūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā.<br><br>Yannūnāhaṁ ñātī upanissāya vihareyyaṁ.<br><br>Ñātī maṁ nissāya dānāni dassanti puññāni karissanti, bhikkhū ca lābhaṁ lacchanti, ahañca piṇḍakena na kilamissāmī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno senāsanaṁ saṁsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena vesālī tena pakkāmi.<br><br>Anupubbena yena vesālī tadavasari. Tatra sudaṁ āyasmā sudinno vesāliyaṁ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṁ.<br><br>Assosuṁ kho āyasmato sudinnassa ñātakā—“sudinno kira kalandaputto vesāliṁ anuppatto”ti. Te āyasmato sudinnassa saṭṭhimatte thālipāke bhattābhihāraṁ abhihariṁsu.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno te saṭṭhimatte thālipāke bhikkhūnaṁ vissajjetvā pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kalandagāmaṁ piṇḍāya pāvisi.<br><br>Kalandagāme sapadānaṁ piṇḍāya caramāno yena sakapitu nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato sudinnassa ñātidāsī ābhidosikaṁ kummāsaṁ chaḍḍetukāmā hoti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno taṁ ñātidāsiṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“sace taṁ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṁ, idha me patte ākirā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa ñātidāsī taṁ ābhidosikaṁ kummāsaṁ āyasmato sudinnassa patte ākirantī hatthānañca pādānañca sarassa ca nimittaṁ aggahesi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa ñātidāsī yenāyasmato sudinnassa mātā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato sudinnassa mātaraṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“yaggheyye, jāneyyāsi,<br><br>ayyaputto sudinno anuppatto”ti.<br><br>“Sace, je, tvaṁ saccaṁ bhaṇasi, adāsiṁ taṁ karomī”ti.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sudinno taṁ ābhidosikaṁ kummāsaṁ aññataraṁ kuṭṭamūlaṁ nissāya paribhuñjati.<br><br>Pitāpi kho āyasmato sudinnassa kammantā āgacchanto addasa āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ taṁ ābhidosikaṁ kummāsaṁ aññataraṁ kuṭṭamūlaṁ nissāya paribhuñjantaṁ.<br><br>Disvāna yenāyasmā sudinno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“atthi nāma, tāta sudinna, ābhidosikaṁ kummāsaṁ paribhuñjissasi.<br><br>Nanu nāma, tāta sudinna, sakaṁ gehaṁ gantabban”ti?<br><br>“Agamimha kho te, gahapati, gehaṁ.<br><br>Tatāyaṁ ābhidosiko kummāso”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa pitā āyasmato sudinnassa bāhāyaṁ gahetvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca— “ehi, tāta sudinna, gharaṁ gamissāmā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno yena sakapitu nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa pitā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca— “bhuñja, tāta sudinnā”ti.<br><br>“Alaṁ, gahapati, kataṁ me ajja bhattakiccan”ti.<br><br>“Adhivāsehi, tāta sudinna, svātanāya bhattan”ti.<br><br>Adhivāsesi kho āyasmā sudinno tuṇhībhāvena. Atha kho āyasmā sudinno uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā tassā rattiyā accayena haritena gomayena pathaviṁ opuñjāpetvā dve puñje kārāpesi—ekaṁ hiraññassa, ekaṁ suvaṇṇassa.<br><br>Tāva mahantā puñjā ahesuṁ, orato ṭhito puriso pārato ṭhitaṁ purisaṁ na passati; pārato ṭhito puriso orato ṭhitaṁ purisaṁ na passati.<br><br>Te puñje kilañjehi paṭicchādāpetvā majjhe āsanaṁ paññāpetvā tirokaraṇīyaṁ parikkhipitvā āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikaṁ āmantesi—<br><br>“tena hi, vadhu, yena alaṅkārena alaṅkatā puttassa me sudinnassa piyā ahosi manāpā tena alaṅkārena alaṅkarā”ti.<br><br>“Evaṁ, ayye”ti, kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmato sudinnassa mātuyā paccassosi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sakapitu nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa pitā yenāyasmā sudinno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā te puñje vivarāpetvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ te, tāta sudinna, mātu mattikaṁ itthikāya itthidhanaṁ, aññaṁ pettikaṁ aññaṁ pitāmahaṁ.<br><br>Labbhā, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhogā ca bhuñjituṁ puññāni ca kātuṁ.<br><br>Ehi tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohī”ti.<br><br>“Tāta, na ussahāmi na visahāmi, abhirato ahaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carāmī”ti.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho āyasmato sudinnassa pitā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ te, tāta sudinna, mātu mattikaṁ, itthikāya itthidhanaṁ, aññaṁ pettikaṁ, aññaṁ pitāmahaṁ.<br><br>Labbhā, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhogā ca bhuñjituṁ puññāni ca kātuṁ.<br><br>Ehi tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohī”ti.<br><br>“Vadeyyāma kho taṁ, gahapati, sace tvaṁ nātikaḍḍheyyāsī”ti.<br><br>“Vadehi, tāta sudinnā”ti.<br><br>“Tena hi tvaṁ, gahapati, mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote opātehi.<br><br>Taṁ kissa hetu?<br><br>Yañhi te, gahapati, bhavissati tatonidānaṁ bhayaṁ vā chambhitattaṁ vā lomahaṁso vā ārakkho vā so te na bhavissatī”ti.<br><br>Evaṁ vutte, āyasmato sudinnassa pitā anattamano ahosi— “kathañhi nāma putto sudinno evaṁ vakkhatī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa pitā āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikaṁ āmantesi—<br><br>“tena hi, vadhu, tvaṁ piyā ca manāpā ca. Appeva nāma putto sudinno tuyhampi vacanaṁ kareyyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmato sudinnassa pādesu gahetvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“kīdisā nāma tā, ayyaputta, accharāyo yāsaṁ tvaṁ hetu brahmacariyaṁ carasī”ti?<br><br>“Na kho ahaṁ, bhagini, accharānaṁ hetu brahmacariyaṁ carāmī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā— “ajjatagge maṁ ayyaputto sudinno bhaginivādena samudācaratī”ti, tattheva mucchitā papatā.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno pitaraṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“sace, gahapati, bhojanaṁ dātabbaṁ detha,<br><br>mā no viheṭhayitthā”ti.<br><br>“Bhuñja, tāta sudinnā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā ca pitā ca āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesuṁ sampavāresuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ bhuttāviṁ onītapattapāṇiṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ, tāta sudinna, kulaṁ aḍḍhaṁ mahaddhanaṁ mahābhogaṁ pahūtajātarūparajataṁ pahūtavittūpakaraṇaṁ pahūtadhanadhaññaṁ.<br><br>Labbhā, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhogā ca bhuñjituṁ puññāni ca kātuṁ.<br><br>Ehi tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohī”ti.<br><br>“Amma, na ussahāmi na visahāmi, abhirato ahaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carāmī”ti.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ, tāta sudinna, kulaṁ aḍḍhaṁ mahaddhanaṁ mahābhogaṁ pahūtajātarūparajataṁ pahūtavittūpakaraṇaṁ pahūtadhanadhaññaṁ.<br><br>Tena hi, tāta sudinna, bījakampi dehi—<br><br>mā no aputtakaṁ sāpateyyaṁ licchavayo atiharāpesun”ti.<br><br>“Etaṁ kho me, amma, sakkā kātun”ti.<br><br>“Kahaṁ pana, tāta sudinna, etarahi viharasī”ti?<br><br>“Mahāvane, ammā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā sudinno uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikaṁ āmantesi—<br><br>“tena hi, vadhu, yadā utunī ahosi, pupphaṁ te uppannaṁ hoti, atha me āroceyyāsī”ti.<br><br>“Evaṁ, ayye”ti kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmato sudinnassa mātuyā paccassosi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā nacirasseva utunī ahosi, pupphaṁsā uppajji.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmato sudinnassa mātaraṁ etadavoca—“utunīmhi, ayye, pupphaṁ me uppannan”ti.<br><br>“Tena hi, vadhu, yena alaṅkārena alaṅkatā puttassa sudinnassa piyā ahosi manāpā tena alaṅkārena alaṅkarā”ti.<br><br>“Evaṁ, ayye”ti kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmato sudinnassa mātuyā paccassosi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikaṁ ādāya yena mahāvanaṁ yenāyasmā sudinno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ, tāta sudinna, kulaṁ aḍḍhaṁ mahaddhanaṁ mahābhogaṁ pahūtajātarūparajataṁ pahūtavittūpakaraṇaṁ pahūtadhanadhaññaṁ.<br><br>Labbhā, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhogā ca bhuñjituṁ puññāni ca kātuṁ.<br><br>Ehi tvaṁ, tāta sudinna, hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohī”ti.<br><br>“Amma, na ussahāmi na visahāmi,<br><br>abhirato ahaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carāmī”ti.<br><br>Dutiyampi kho …pe…<br><br>tatiyampi kho āyasmato sudinnassa mātā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“idaṁ, tāta sudinna, kulaṁ aḍḍhaṁ mahaddhanaṁ mahābhogaṁ pahūtajātarūparajataṁ pahūtavittūpakaraṇaṁ pahūtadhanadhaññaṁ.<br><br>Tena hi, tāta sudinna, bījakampi dehi—<br><br>mā no aputtakaṁ sāpateyyaṁ licchavayo atiharāpesun”ti.<br><br>“Etaṁ kho me, amma, sakkā kātun”ti,<br><br>purāṇadutiyikāya bāhāyaṁ gahetvā mahāvanaṁ ajjhogāhetvā apaññatte sikkhāpade anādīnavadasso purāṇadutiyikāya tikkhattuṁ methunaṁ dhammaṁ abhiviññāpesi.<br><br>Sā tena gabbhaṁ gaṇhi.<br><br>Bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṁ—<br><br>“nirabbudo vata bho bhikkhusaṅgho nirādīnavo;<br><br>sudinnena kalandaputtena abbudaṁ uppāditaṁ, ādīnavo uppādito”ti.<br><br>Bhummānaṁ devānaṁ saddaṁ sutvā cātumahārājikā devā saddamanussāvesuṁ …pe…<br><br>tāvatiṁsā devā …<br><br>yāmā devā …<br><br>tusitā devā …<br><br>nimmānaratī devā …<br><br>paranimmitavasavattī devā …<br><br>brahmakāyikā devā saddamanussāvesuṁ—<br><br>“nirabbudo vata bho bhikkhusaṅgho nirādīnavo;<br><br>sudinnena kalandaputtena abbudaṁ uppāditaṁ, ādīnavo uppādito”ti.<br><br>Itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikā tassa gabbhassa paripākamanvāya puttaṁ vijāyi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa sahāyakā tassa dārakassa bījakoti nāmaṁ akaṁsu.<br><br>Āyasmato sudinnassa purāṇadutiyikāya bījakamātāti nāmaṁ akaṁsu.<br><br>Āyasmato sudinnassa bījakapitāti nāmaṁ akaṁsu.<br><br>Te aparena samayena ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajitvā arahattaṁ sacchākaṁsu.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa ahudeva kukkuccaṁ, ahu vippaṭisāro—<br><br>“alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā; dulladdhaṁ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṁ;<br><br>yohaṁ evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā nāsakkhiṁ yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ caritun”ti.<br><br>So teneva kukkuccena tena vippaṭisārena kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto antomano līnamano dukkhī dummano vippaṭisārī pajjhāyi.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmato sudinnassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ etadavocuṁ—<br><br>“pubbe kho tvaṁ, āvuso sudinna, vaṇṇavā ahosi pīṇindriyo pasannamukhavaṇṇo vippasannachavivaṇṇo;<br><br>so dāni tvaṁ etarahi kiso lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto antomano līnamano dukkhī dummano vippaṭisārī pajjhāyasi.<br><br>Kacci no tvaṁ, āvuso sudinna, anabhirato brahmacariyaṁ carasī”ti?<br><br>“Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, anabhirato brahmacariyaṁ carāmi.<br><br>Atthi me pāpakammaṁ kataṁ;<br><br>purāṇadutiyikāya methuno dhammo paṭisevito;<br><br>tassa mayhaṁ, āvuso, ahudeva kukkuccaṁ ahu vippaṭisāro—<br><br>‘alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā; dulladdhaṁ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṁ; yohaṁ evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā nāsakkhiṁ yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ caritun’”ti.<br><br>“Alañhi te, āvuso sudinna, kukkuccāya alaṁ vippaṭisārāya yaṁ tvaṁ evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā na sakkhissasi yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ.<br><br>Nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito, no sarāgāya;<br><br>visaṁyogāya dhammo desito, no saṁyogāya;<br><br>anupādānāya dhammo desito, no saupādānāya.<br><br>Tattha nāma tvaṁ, āvuso, bhagavatā virāgāya dhamme desite sarāgāya cetessasi, visaṁyogāya dhamme desite saṁyogāya cetessasi, anupādānāya dhamme desite saupādānāya cetessasi.<br><br>Nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā anekapariyāyena rāgavirāgāya dhammo desito,<br><br>madanimmadanāya pipāsavinayāya ālayasamugghātāya vaṭṭupacchedāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammo desito.<br><br>Nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā anekapariyāyena kāmānaṁ pahānaṁ akkhātaṁ,<br><br>kāmasaññānaṁ pariññā akkhātā,<br><br>kāmapipāsānaṁ paṭivinayo akkhāto,<br><br>kāmavitakkānaṁ samugghāto akkhāto,<br><br>kāmapariḷāhānaṁ vūpasamo akkhāto.<br><br>Netaṁ, āvuso, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya, pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya.<br><br>Atha khvetaṁ, āvuso, appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā etasmiṁ nidāne etasmiṁ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṁ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ paṭipucchi—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira tvaṁ, sudinna, purāṇadutiyikāya methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevī”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, bhagavā”ti.<br><br>Vigarahi buddho bhagavā—<br><br>“ananucchavikaṁ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṁ appaṭirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā na sakkhissasi yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ.<br><br>Nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito, no sarāgāya;<br><br>visaṁyogāya dhammo desito, no saṁyogāya;<br><br>anupādānāya dhammo desito, no saupādānāya.<br><br>Tattha nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, mayā virāgāya dhamme desite sarāgāya cetessasi, visaṁyogāya dhamme desite saṁyogāya cetessasi, anupādānāya dhamme desite saupādānāya cetessasi.<br><br>Nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena rāgavirāgāya dhammo desito.<br><br>Madanimmadanāya pipāsavinayāya ālayasamugghātāya vaṭṭupacchedāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammo desito.<br><br>Nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena kāmānaṁ pahānaṁ akkhātaṁ,<br><br>kāmasaññānaṁ pariññā akkhātā,<br><br>kāmapipāsānaṁ paṭivinayo akkhāto,<br><br>kāmavitakkānaṁ samugghāto akkhāto,<br><br>kāmapariḷāhānaṁ vūpasamo akkhāto.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, āsivisassa ghoravisassa mukhe aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva mātugāmassa aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, kaṇhasappassa mukhe aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva mātugāmassa aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, aṅgārakāsuyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva mātugāmassa aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Taṁ kissa hetu?<br><br>Tatonidānañhi, moghapurisa, maraṇaṁ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṁ vā dukkhaṁ, na tveva tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyya.<br><br>Itonidānañca kho, moghapurisa, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyya.<br><br>Tattha nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, yaṁ tvaṁ asaddhammaṁ gāmadhammaṁ vasaladhammaṁ duṭṭhullaṁ odakantikaṁ rahassaṁ dvayaṁdvayasamāpattiṁ samāpajjissasi,<br><br>bahūnaṁ kho tvaṁ, moghapurisa, akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ ādikattā pubbaṅgamo.<br><br>Netaṁ, moghapurisa, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya, pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya;<br><br>atha khvetaṁ, moghapurisa, appasannānañceva appasādāya, pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ sudinnaṁ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya dupposatāya mahicchatāya asantuṭṭhitāya saṅgaṇikāya kosajjassa avaṇṇaṁ bhāsitvā anekapariyāyena subharatāya suposatāya appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa vīriyārambhassa vaṇṇaṁ bhāsitvā<br><br>bhikkhūnaṁ tadanucchavikaṁ tadanulomikaṁ dhammiṁ kathaṁ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi—<br><br>“tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca—<br><br>saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṁ puggalānaṁ niggahāya, pesalānaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṁ āsavānaṁ saṁvarāya, samparāyikānaṁ āsavānaṁ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṁ pasādāya, pasannānaṁ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinayānuggahāya.<br><br>Evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ uddiseyyātha—<br><br>“Yo pana bhikkhu methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭiseveyya, pārājiko hoti asaṁvāso”ti.<br><br>Evañcidaṁ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ hoti.<br><br>Sudinnabhāṇavāro niṭṭhito.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu vesāliyaṁ mahāvane makkaṭiṁ āmisena upalāpetvā tassā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevati.<br><br>Atha kho so bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṁ ādāya vesāliṁ piṇḍāya pāvisi.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū senāsanacārikaṁ āhiṇḍantā yena tassa bhikkhuno vihāro tenupasaṅkamiṁsu.<br><br>Addasa kho sā makkaṭī te bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante.<br><br>Disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā tesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ purato kaṭimpi cālesi cheppampi cālesi, kaṭimpi oḍḍi, nimittampi akāsi.<br><br>Atha kho tesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ etadahosi—“nissaṁsayaṁ kho so bhikkhu imissā makkaṭiyā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevatī”ti. Ekamantaṁ nilīyiṁsu.<br><br>Atha kho so bhikkhu vesāliyaṁ piṇḍāya caritvā piṇḍapātaṁ ādāya paṭikkami.<br><br>Atha kho sā makkaṭī yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami.<br><br>Atha kho so bhikkhu taṁ piṇḍapātaṁ ekadesaṁ bhuñjitvā ekadesaṁ tassā makkaṭiyā adāsi.<br><br>Atha kho sā makkaṭī taṁ piṇḍapātaṁ bhuñjitvā tassa bhikkhuno kaṭiṁ oḍḍi. Atha kho so bhikkhu tassā makkaṭiyā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevati.<br><br>Atha kho te bhikkhū taṁ bhikkhuṁ etadavocuṁ—“nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ;<br><br>kissa tvaṁ, āvuso, makkaṭiyā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevasī”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, āvuso, bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ; tañca kho manussitthiyā, no tiracchānagatāyā”ti.<br><br>“Nanu, āvuso, tatheva taṁ hoti.<br><br>Ananucchavikaṁ, āvuso, ananulomikaṁ appaṭirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tvaṁ, āvuso, evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā na sakkhissasi yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ.<br><br>Nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito, no sarāgāya …pe…<br><br>kāmapariḷāhānaṁ vūpasamo akkhāto.<br><br>Netaṁ, āvuso, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya.<br><br>Atha khvetaṁ, āvuso, appasannānañceva appasādāya, pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho te bhikkhū taṁ bhikkhuṁ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā etasmiṁ nidāne etasmiṁ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṁ sannipātāpetvā taṁ bhikkhuṁ paṭipucchi—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira tvaṁ, bhikkhu, makkaṭiyā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevī”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, bhagavā”ti.<br><br>Vigarahi buddho bhagavā—<br><br>“ananucchavikaṁ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṁ appatirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā na sakkhissasi yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ.<br><br>Nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito, no sarāgāya …pe…<br><br>kāmapariḷāhānaṁ vūpasamo akkhāto.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, āsivisassa ghoravisassa mukhe aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva makkaṭiyā aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, kaṇhasappassa mukhe aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva makkaṭiyā aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Varaṁ te, moghapurisa, aṅgārakāsuyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ, na tveva makkaṭiyā aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṁ pakkhittaṁ.<br><br>Taṁ kissa hetu?<br><br>Tatonidānañhi, moghapurisa, maraṇaṁ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṁ vā dukkhaṁ;<br><br>na tveva tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyya.<br><br>Itonidānañca kho, moghapurisa, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyya.<br><br>Tattha nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, yaṁ tvaṁ asaddhammaṁ gāmadhammaṁ vasaladhammaṁ duṭṭhullaṁ odakantikaṁ rahassaṁ dvayaṁdvayasamāpattiṁ samāpajjissasi.<br><br>Netaṁ, moghapurisa, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya …pe…<br><br>evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ uddiseyyātha—<br><br>“Yo pana bhikkhu methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭiseveyya antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi, pārājiko hoti asaṁvāso”ti.<br><br>Evañcidaṁ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ hoti.<br><br>Makkaṭīvatthu niṭṭhitaṁ.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū yāvadatthaṁ bhuñjiṁsu, yāvadatthaṁ supiṁsu, yāvadatthaṁ nhāyiṁsu.<br><br>Yāvadatthaṁ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṁ supitvā yāvadatthaṁ nhāyitvā ayoniso manasi karitvā sikkhaṁ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṁ anāvikatvā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭiseviṁsu.<br><br>Te aparena samayena ñātibyasanenapi phuṭṭhā bhogabyasanenapi phuṭṭhā rogabyasanenapi phuṭṭhā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ upasaṅkamitvā evaṁ vadanti—<br><br>“na mayaṁ, bhante ānanda, buddhagarahino na dhammagarahino na saṅghagarahino;<br><br>attagarahino mayaṁ, bhante ānanda, anaññagarahino.<br><br>Mayamevamhā alakkhikā mayaṁ appapuññā,<br><br>ye mayaṁ evaṁ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitvā nāsakkhimhā yāvajīvaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carituṁ.<br><br>Idāni cepi mayaṁ, bhante ānanda, labheyyāma bhagavato santike pabbajjaṁ labheyyāma upasampadaṁ, idānipi mayaṁ vipassakā kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ pubbarattāpararattaṁ bodhipakkhikānaṁ dhammānaṁ bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā vihareyyāma.<br><br>Sādhu, bhante ānanda, bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocehī”ti.<br><br>“Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā ānando vesālikānaṁ vajjiputtakānaṁ paṭissuṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesi.<br><br>“Aṭṭhānametaṁ, ānanda, anavakāso yaṁ tathāgato vajjīnaṁ vā vajjiputtakānaṁ vā kāraṇā sāvakānaṁ pārājikaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ samūhaneyyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā etasmiṁ nidāne etasmiṁ pakaraṇe dhammiṁ kathaṁ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi—<br><br>“yo, bhikkhave, sikkhaṁ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṁ anāvikatvā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevati so āgato na upasampādetabbo.<br><br>Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, sikkhaṁ paccakkhāya dubbalyaṁ āvikatvā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevati so āgato upasampādetabbo.<br><br>Evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ uddiseyyātha—	Yo panāti<br><br>yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. Eso vuccati “yo panā”ti.<br><br>Bhikkhūti<br><br>bhikkhakoti bhikkhu,<br><br>bhikkhācariyaṁ ajjhupagatoti bhikkhu,<br><br>bhinnapaṭadharoti bhikkhu,<br><br>samaññāya bhikkhu,<br><br>paṭiññāya bhikkhu,<br><br>ehi bhikkhūti bhikkhu,<br><br>tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampannoti bhikkhu,<br><br>bhadro bhikkhu,<br><br>sāro bhikkhu,<br><br>sekho bhikkhu,<br><br>asekho bhikkhu,<br><br>samaggena saṅghena ñatticatutthena kammena akuppena ṭhānārahena upasampannoti bhikkhu.<br><br>Tatra yvāyaṁ bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ñatticatutthena kammena akuppena ṭhānārahena upasampanno, ayaṁ imasmiṁ atthe adhippeto bhikkhūti.<br><br>Sikkhāti<br><br>tisso sikkhā—adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.<br><br>Tatra yāyaṁ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṁ imasmiṁ atthe adhippetā sikkhāti.<br><br>Sājīvaṁ nāma<br><br>yaṁ bhagavatā paññattaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ, etaṁ sājīvaṁ nāma.<br><br>Tasmiṁ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpannoti.<br><br>Sikkhaṁ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṁ anāvikatvāti<br><br>atthi, bhikkhave, dubbalyāvikammañceva hoti sikkhā ca apaccakkhātā;<br><br>atthi, bhikkhave, dubbalyāvikammañceva hoti sikkhā ca paccakkhātā.<br><br>Kathañca, bhikkhave, dubbalyāvikammañceva hoti sikkhā ca apaccakkhātā.<br><br>Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkaṇṭhito anabhirato sāmaññā cavitukāmo<br><br>bhikkhubhāvaṁ aṭṭīyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno<br><br>gihibhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>upāsakabhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>ārāmikabhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>sāmaṇerabhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>titthiyabhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>titthiyasāvakabhāvaṁ patthayamāno<br><br>assamaṇabhāvaṁ …pe…<br><br>“hoti me asakyaputtiyo assan”ti vadati viññāpeti.<br><br>Evampi, bhikkhave, dubbalyāvikammañceva hoti sikkhā ca apaccakkhātā.<br><br>Atha vā pana ukkaṇṭhito anabhirato sāmaññā sikkhā ca paccakkhātā.<br><br>Kathañca, bhikkhave, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā?<br><br>Idha, bhikkhave, yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi ummattako sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Ummattakassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Khittacitto sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Khittacittassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Vedanāṭṭo sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Vedanāṭṭassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Devatāya santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Tiracchānagatassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Ariyakena milakkhassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, so ca na paṭivijānāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Milakkhakena ariyassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, so ca na paṭivijānāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Ariyakena ariyassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, so ca na paṭivijānāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Milakkhakena milakkhassa santike sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, so ca na paṭivijānāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Davāya sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Ravāya sikkhaṁ paccakkhāti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Asāvetukāmo sāveti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Sāvetukāmo na sāveti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Aviññussa sāveti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Viññussa na sāveti, apaccakkhātā hoti sikkhā.<br><br>Sabbaso vā pana na sāveti, Matches Bu PJ 2	Uses 'bhikkhunī', coriṁ, corāsi bālāsi mūḷhāsi thenāsīti,&nbsp;&nbsp;'ādiyamānā', 'pārājikā', asaṁvāsā	If a nun, intending to steal, takes from an inhabited area or from the wilderness what has not been given to her—the sort of stealing for which kings, having caught a thief, would beat, imprison, or banish her, saying, ‘You’re a bandit, you’re a fool, you’ve gone astray, you’re a thief’—she too is expelled and excluded from the community.	Pārājikuddeso		[sound:Bi_PJ_2.mp3]	25	"At one time the Buddha was staying on the Vulture Peak at Rājagaha.<br><br>At that time a number of monks who were friends had made grass huts on the slope of Mount Isigili and had entered the rainy-season residence there.<br><br>Among them was Venerable Dhaniya the potter.<br><br>When the three months were over and they had completed the rainy-season residence, the monks demolished their grass huts, put away the grass and sticks, and left to wander the country.<br><br>But Venerable Dhaniya spent the winter and the summer right there.<br><br>Then, on one occasion, while Dhaniya was in the village to collect almsfood, some women gathering grass and firewood demolished his grass hut and took away the grass and sticks.<br><br>A second time Dhaniya collected grass and sticks and made a grass hut,<br><br>and again the hut was demolished in the same way.<br><br>The same thing happened a third time.<br><br>Dhaniya thought,<br><br>“Three times this has happened.<br><br>But I’m well-trained and experienced in my own craft of pottery.<br><br>Why don’t I knead mud myself and make a hut entirely of clay?”<br><br>And he did just that. He then collected grass, sticks, and cow-dung, and he baked his hut.<br><br>It was a pretty and attractive little hut, red in color like a scarlet rain-mite.<br><br>And when struck, it sounded just like a bell.<br><br>Soon afterwards the Buddha was descending from the Vulture Peak with a number of monks when he saw that hut.<br><br>He said to the monks,<br><br>“What’s this pretty and attractive thing that’s red in color like a scarlet rain-mite?”<br><br>The monks told the Buddha,<br><br>who then rebuked Dhaniya:<br><br>“It’s not suitable for that foolish man, it’s not proper, it’s not worthy of a monastic, it’s not allowable, it’s not to be done.<br><br>How could he make a hut entirely of clay?<br><br>Doesn’t he have any consideration, compassion, and mercy for living beings?<br><br>Go, monks, and demolish this hut,<br><br>so that future generations don’t follow his example.<br><br>And, monks, you shouldn’t make a hut entirely of clay.<br><br>If you do, you commit an offense of wrong conduct.”<br><br>Saying, “Yes, sir,” they went to demolish it.<br><br>And Dhaniya said to them,<br><br>“Why are you demolishing my hut?”<br><br>“The Buddha has asked us to.”<br><br>“Demolish it then, if the Lord of the Truth has said so.”<br><br>Dhaniya thought,<br><br>“Three times, while I was in the village to collect almsfood, women gathering grass and firewood demolished my hut and took away the grass and sticks.<br><br>And now my hut made entirely of clay has been demolished at the Buddha’s request.<br><br>Now, the caretaker of the woodyard is a friend of mine.<br><br>Why don’t I ask him for timber and make a hut out of that?”<br><br>Dhaniya then went to the caretaker of the woodyard and told him what had happened,<br><br>adding, “Please give me some timber,<br><br>I want to make a wooden hut.”<br><br>“There’s no timber, sir, that I could give you.<br><br>This timber is held by the king. It’s meant for repairs of the town and put aside in case of an emergency.<br><br>You can only have it if the king gives it away.”<br><br>“Actually, it’s been given by the king.”<br><br>The caretaker of the woodyard thought,<br><br>“These Sakyan monastics have integrity. They are celibate and their conduct is good, and they are truthful, moral, and have a good character.<br><br>Even the king has faith in them.<br><br>These venerables wouldn’t say something is given if it wasn’t.”<br><br>And he said to Dhaniya,<br><br>“You may take it, sir.”<br><br>Dhaniya then had that timber cut into pieces, took it away on carts, and made a wooden hut.<br><br>Soon afterwards the brahmin Vassakāra, the chief minister of Magadha, was inspecting the public works in Rājagaha when he went to the caretaker of the woodyard and said,<br><br>“What’s going on?<br><br>Where’s the timber held by the king that’s meant for repairs of the town and put aside in case of an emergency?”<br><br>“The king has given it to Venerable Dhaniya.”<br><br>Vassakāra was upset and thought,<br><br>“How could the king give away this timber to Dhaniya the potter?”<br><br>He then went to King Seniya Bimbisāra of Magadha and said,<br><br>“Is it true, sir, that you have given away to Dhaniya the potter the timber that was held for repairs of the town and put aside in case of an emergency?”<br><br>“Who said that?”<br><br>“The caretaker of the woodyard.”<br><br>“Well then, brahmin, summon the caretaker of the woodyard.”<br><br>And Vassakāra had the caretaker of the woodyard bound and taken by force.<br><br>Dhaniya saw this<br><br>and said to him,<br><br>“Why is this happening to you?”<br><br>“Because of the timber, sir.”<br><br>“Go then, and I’ll come too.”<br><br>“Please come before I’m done for.”<br><br>Dhaniya then went to King Bimbisāra’s house and sat down on the prepared seat.<br><br>The king approached Dhaniya, bowed, sat down,<br><br>and said,<br><br>“Is it true, venerable, that I have given to you the timber held for repairs of the town and put aside in case of an emergency?”<br><br>“Yes, great king.”<br><br>“We kings are very busy—<br><br>we may give and not remember.<br><br>Please remind me.”<br><br>“Do you remember, great king, when you were first sense of conscience, and who were contented, afraid of wrongdoing, and fond of the training, complained and criticized Venerable Dhaniya,<br><br>“How could he take the king’s timber without it being sir, or the value of a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i>.”<br><br>At that time in Rājagaha a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i> coin was worth five <i lang=""pi"" proper, it’s not worthy of a monastic, it’s not allowable, it’s not to be done.<br><br>How could you do this?<br><br>This will affect people’s confidence,<br><br>and cause some to lose it.”<br><br>Then, after rebuking the monks from the group of six in many ways, the Buddha spoke in dispraise of being difficult to support …<br><br>but he spoke in praise of … being energetic. Having given a teaching on what is right and proper, he addressed the monks …<br><br>“And so, monks, this training rule should be recited like this:"	"A:<br><br>whoever …<br><br>Monk:<br><br>… The monk who has been given the full ordination by a unanimous Sangha through a legal procedure consisting of one motion and three announcements that is irreversible and fit to stand—this sort of monk is meant in this case.<br><br>An inhabited area:<br><br>an inhabited area of one hut, an inhabited area of two huts, an inhabited area of three huts, an inhabited area of four huts, an inhabited area with people, an inhabited area without people, an enclosed inhabited area, an unenclosed inhabited area, a disorganized inhabited area, and even a caravan settled for more than four months is called “an inhabited area”.<br><br>The access to an inhabited area:<br><br>of an enclosed inhabited area: a stone’s throw of a man of average height standing at the threshold of the gateway to the inhabited area;<br><br>of an unenclosed inhabited area: a stone’s throw of a man of average height standing at the access to a house.<br><br>The wilderness:<br><br>apart from inhabited areas and the access to inhabited areas, the remainder is called “the wilderness”.<br><br>What has not been given:<br><br>what has not been given, what has not been let go of, what has not been relinquished; what is guarded, what is protected, what is regarded as “mine”, what belongs to someone else. This is called “what has not been given”.<br><br>Intending to steal:<br><br>the thought of theft, the thought of stealing.<br><br>Takes:<br><br>takes, carries off, steals, interrupts the movement of, moves from its base, does not stick to an arrangement.<br><br>The sort:<br><br>a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i> coin, the value of a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i>, or more than a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i>.<br><br>Kings:<br><br>kings of the earth, kings of a region, rulers of islands, rulers of border areas, judges, government officials, or whoever metes out physical punishment—these are called “kings”.<br><br>A thief:<br><br>whoever, intending to steal, takes anything that has not been given, having a value of five <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">māsaka</i> coins or more—he is called “a thief”.<br><br>Would beat:<br><br>would beat with the hand, the foot, a whip, a cane, a cudgel, or by mutilation.<br><br>Would imprison:<br><br>would imprison by constricting with a rope, by constricting with shackles, by constricting with chains, by constricting to a house, by constricting to a city, by constricting to a village, by constricting to a town, or by guarding.<br><br>Would banish:<br><br>would banish from a village, from a town, from a city, from a country, or from a district.<br><br>You’re a bandit, you’re a fool, you’ve gone astray, you’re a thief:<br><br>this is a rebuke.<br><br>He too:<br><br>this is said with reference to the preceding offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>Is expelled:<br><br>just as a fallen, withered leaf is incapable of becoming green again,<br><br>so too is a monk who, intending to steal, takes an ungiven <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i> coin, the value of a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i>, or more than a <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">pāda</i>, not an ascetic, not a Sakyan monastic. Therefore it is said, “he is expelled.”<br><br>Excluded from the community:<br><br>Community: joint legal procedures, a joint recitation, the same training—this is called “community”.<br><br>He does not take part in this—therefore it is called “excluded from the community”.<br><br>Being underground, being on the ground, being in the air, being above ground, being in water, being in a boat, being in a vehicle, carried as a load, being in a park, being in a monastic dwelling, being in a field, being on a site, being in an inhabited area, being in the wilderness, water, tooth cleaner, forest tree, that which is carried, that which is deposited, customs station, a living being, footless, two-footed, four-footed, many-footed, a spy, a keeper of entrusted property, mutually agreed stealing, acting by arrangement, making a sign.<br><br><b>Exposition</b><br><br>Being underground:<br><br>the goods have been placed underground, buried, concealed.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he thinks, “I’ll steal the underground goods,” and he seeks for a companion, seeks for a spade or a basket, or goes there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he breaks a twig or a creeper growing there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he digs the soil or heaps it up or removes it, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he touches the container, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes it stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves it from its base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he puts his own vessel into the container and touches something worth five <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">māsaka</i> coins or more, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes it stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he makes it enter his own vessel or takes it with his fist, there is an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he touches goods made of string—an ornamental hanging string, a necklace, an ornamental girdle, a wrap garment, or a turban—he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes it stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he grasps it at the top and pulls it, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he rubs it while lifting it, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he removes the goods even as much as a hair’s breadth over the rim of the container, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he drinks—in a single action—ghee, oil, honey, or syrup having a value of five <i lang=""pi"" translate=""no"">māsaka</i> coins or more, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If he destroys it, throws it away, burns it, or renders it useless, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>Being on the ground:<br><br>the goods have been placed on the ground.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he thinks, “I’ll steal the goods on the ground,” and he either searches for a companion or goes there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he touches them, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes them stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves them from their base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>Being in the air:<br><br>the goods are in the air—<br><br>a peacock, a partridge, or a quail; or a wrap garment or a turban; or money or gold that falls after being cut loose.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he thinks, “I’ll steal the goods in the air,” and he either searches for a companion or goes there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he cuts off their course of movement, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he touches them, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes them stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves them from their base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>Being above ground:<br><br>the goods are above ground—<br><br>on a bed, on a bench, on a bamboo robe rack, on a clothesline, on a wall peg, in a tree, or even just on a bowl rest.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he thinks, “I’ll steal the goods that are above ground,” and he either searches for a companion or goes there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he touches them, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes them stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves them from their base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>Being in the water:<br><br>the goods have been placed in a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves them from their base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he touches either a red or white lotus or a blue water lily base, he commits an offense entailing expulsion.<br><br>If, intending to steal, he thinks, “I’ll steal the vehicle,” and he either searches for a companion or goes there, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he touches it, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.<br><br>If he makes it stir, he commits a serious offense.<br><br>If he moves it from its base, he commits an offense āyasmato dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa etadahosi—<br><br>“yāvatatiyakaṁ kho me gāmaṁ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṁ bhinditvā tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca ādāya agamaṁsu.<br><br>Yāpi mayā sabbamattikāmayā kuṭikā katā sāpi bhagavatā bhedāpitā.<br><br>Atthi ca me dārugahe gaṇako sandiṭṭho.<br><br>Yannūnāhaṁ dārugahe gaṇakaṁ dārūni yācitvā dārukuṭikaṁ kareyyan”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto yena dārugahe gaṇako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā dārugahe gaṇakaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“yāvatatiyakaṁ kho me, āvuso, gāmaṁ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṁ bhinditvā tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca ādāya agamaṁsu.<br><br>Yāpi mayā sabbamattikāmayā kuṭikā katā sāpi bhagavatā bhedāpitā.<br><br>Dehi me, āvuso, dārūni.<br><br>Icchāmi dārukuṭikaṁ kātun”ti.<br><br>“Natthi, bhante, tādisāni dārūni yānāhaṁ ayyassa dadeyyaṁ.<br><br>Atthi, bhante, devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni.<br><br>Sace tāni dārūni rājā dāpeti harāpetha, bhante”ti.<br><br>“Dinnāni, āvuso, raññā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho dārugahe gaṇakassa etadahosi—<br><br>“ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.<br><br>Rājāpimesaṁ abhippasanno.<br><br>Nārahati adinnaṁ dinnanti vattun”ti.<br><br>Atha kho dārugahe gaṇako āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“harāpetha, bhante”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tāni dārūni khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṁ chedāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā dārukuṭikaṁ akāsi.<br><br>Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rājagahe kammante anusaññāyamāno yena dārugahe gaṇako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā dārugahe gaṇakaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“yāni tāni, bhaṇe,<br><br>devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni kahaṁ tāni dārūnī”ti?<br><br>“Tāni, sāmi, dārūni devena ayyassa dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dinnānī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto anattamano ahosi—<br><br>“kathañhi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṁ māgadhaṁ seniyaṁ bimbisāraṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira devena devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dinnānī”ti?<br><br>“Ko evamāhā”ti?<br><br>“Dārugahe gaṇako, devā”ti.<br><br>“Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, dārugahe gaṇakaṁ āṇāpehī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto dārugahe gaṇakaṁ bandhaṁ āṇāpesi.<br><br>Addasa kho āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto dārugahe gaṇakaṁ bandhaṁ niyyamānaṁ.<br><br>Disvāna dārugahe gaṇakaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“kissa tvaṁ, āvuso, bandho niyyāsī”ti?<br><br>“Tesaṁ, bhante, dārūnaṁ kiccā”ti.<br><br>“Gacchāvuso, ahampi āgacchāmī”ti.<br><br>“Eyyāsi, bhante, purāhaṁ haññāmī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto yena rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa nivesanaṁ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.<br><br>Atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yenāyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.<br><br>Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira mayā, bhante, devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni ayyassa dinnānī”ti?<br><br>“Evaṁ, mahārājā”ti.<br><br>“Mayaṁ kho, bhante, rājāno nāma bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā,<br><br>datvāpi na sareyyāma;<br><br>iṅgha, bhante, sarāpehī”ti.<br><br>“Sarasi tvaṁ, mahārāja, paṭhamābhisitto evarūpiṁ vācaṁ bhāsitā—<br><br>‘dinnaññeva samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṁ paribhuñjantū’”ti.<br><br>“Sarāmahaṁ, bhante.<br><br>Santi, bhante, samaṇabrāhmaṇā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā.<br><br>Tesaṁ appamattakepi kukkuccaṁ uppajjati.<br><br>Tesaṁ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṁ, tañca kho araññe apariggahitaṁ.<br><br>So tvaṁ, bhante, tena lesena dārūni adinnaṁ harituṁ maññasi.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṁ vā brāhmaṇaṁ vā vijite vasantaṁ haneyya vā bandheyya vā pabbājeyya vā.<br><br>Gaccha, bhante, lomena tvaṁ muttosi.<br><br>Māssu punapi evarūpaṁ akāsī”ti.<br><br>Manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti—<br><br>“alajjino ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dussīlā musāvādino.<br><br>Ime hi nāma dhammacārino samacārino brāhmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā paṭijānissanti.<br><br>Natthi imesaṁ sāmaññaṁ, natthi imesaṁ brahmaññaṁ.<br><br>Naṭṭhaṁ imesaṁ sāmaññaṁ, naṭṭhaṁ imesaṁ brahmaññaṁ.<br><br>Kuto imesaṁ sāmaññaṁ, kuto imesaṁ brahmaññaṁ.<br><br>Apagatā ime sāmaññā, apagatā ime brahmaññā.<br><br>Rājānampi ime vañcenti, kiṁ panaññe manusse”ti.<br><br>Assosuṁ kho bhikkhū tesaṁ manussānaṁ ujjhāyantānaṁ khiyyantānaṁ vipācentānaṁ.<br><br>Ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti—<br><br>“kathañhi nāma āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṁ ādiyissatī”ti.<br><br>Atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā etasmiṁ nidāne etasmiṁ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṁ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ paṭipucchi—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira tvaṁ, dhaniya, rañño dārūni adinnaṁ ādiyī”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, bhagavā”ti.<br><br>Vigarahi buddho bhagavā—<br><br>“ananucchavikaṁ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṁ appatirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tvaṁ, moghapurisa, rañño dārūni adinnaṁ ādiyissasi.<br><br>Netaṁ, moghapurisa, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya;<br><br>atha khvetaṁ, moghapurisa, appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇavohāriko mahāmatto bhikkhūsu pabbajito bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā taṁ bhikkhuṁ etadavoca—<br><br>“kittakena kho, bhikkhu, rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro coraṁ gahetvā hanati vā bandhati vā pabbājeti vā”ti?<br><br>“Pādena vā, bhagavā, pādārahena vā”ti.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena rājagahe pañcamāsako pādo hoti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ dhaniyaṁ kumbhakāraputtaṁ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya …pe…<br><br>evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ uddiseyyātha—<br><br>“Yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṁ theyyasaṅkhātaṁ ādiyeyya,<br><br>yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṁ gahetvā haneyyuṁ vā bandheyyuṁ vā pabbājeyyuṁ vā—‘corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosī’ti, tathārūpaṁ bhikkhu adinnaṁ ādiyamāno<br><br>ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṁvāso”ti.<br><br>Evañcidaṁ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ hoti.<br><br>Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rajakattharaṇaṁ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharitvā ārāmaṁ haritvā bhājesuṁ.<br><br>Bhikkhū evamāhaṁsu—<br><br>“mahāpuññattha tumhe, āvuso.<br><br>Bahuṁ tumhākaṁ cīvaraṁ uppannan”ti.<br><br>“Kuto, āvuso, amhākaṁ puññaṁ,<br><br>idāni mayaṁ rajakattharaṇaṁ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharimhā”ti.<br><br>“Nanu, āvuso, bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ.<br><br>Kissa tumhe, āvuso, rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharitthā”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, āvuso, bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṁ paññattaṁ.<br><br>Tañca kho gāme, no araññe”ti.<br><br>“Nanu, āvuso, tathevetaṁ hoti.<br><br>Ananucchavikaṁ, āvuso, ananulomikaṁ appatirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tumhe, āvuso, rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharissatha.<br><br>Netaṁ, āvuso, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya;<br><br>atha khvetaṁ, āvuso, appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho te bhikkhū chabbaggiye bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocesuṁ.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā etasmiṁ nidāne etasmiṁ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṁ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi—<br><br>“saccaṁ kira tumhe, bhikkhave, rajakattharaṇaṁ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharitthā”ti?<br><br>“Saccaṁ, bhagavā”ti.<br><br>Vigarahi buddho bhagavā—<br><br>“ananucchavikaṁ, moghapurisā, ananulomikaṁ appaṭirūpaṁ assāmaṇakaṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ.<br><br>Kathañhi nāma tumhe, moghapurisā, rajakabhaṇḍikaṁ avaharissatha.<br><br>Netaṁ, moghapurisā, appasannānaṁ vā pasādāya pasannānaṁ vā bhiyyobhāvāya;<br><br>atha khvetaṁ, moghapurisā, appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṁ aññathattāyā”ti.<br><br>Atha kho bhagavā chabbaggiye bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya …pe…<br><br>vīriyārambhassa vaṇṇaṁ bhāsitvā bhikkhūnaṁ tadanucchavikaṁ tadanulomikaṁ dhammiṁ kathaṁ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi … pe<br><br>… evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṁ sikkhāpadaṁ uddiseyyātha—	Yo panāti<br><br>yo yādiso …pe…<br><br>bhikkhūti<br><br>…pe… ayaṁ imasmiṁ atthe adhippeto bhikkhūti.<br><br>Gāmo nāma<br><br>ekakuṭikopi gāmo, dvikuṭikopi gāmo, tikuṭikopi gāmo, catukuṭikopi gāmo, samanussopi gāmo, amanussopi gāmo, parikkhittopi gāmo, aparikkhittopi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭhopi gāmo, yopi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho sopi vuccati gāmo.<br><br>Gāmūpacāro nāma<br><br>parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto,<br><br>aparikkhittassa gāmassa gharūpacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.<br><br>Araññaṁ nāma<br><br>ṭhapetvā gāmañca gāmūpacārañca avasesaṁ araññaṁ nāma.<br><br>Adinnaṁ nāma<br><br>yaṁ adinnaṁ anissaṭṭhaṁ apariccattaṁ rakkhitaṁ gopitaṁ mamāyitaṁ parapariggahitaṁ. Etaṁ adinnaṁ nāma.<br><br>Theyyasaṅkhātanti<br><br>theyyacitto avaharaṇacitto.<br><br>Ādiyeyyāti<br><br>ādiyeyya hareyya avahareyya iriyāpathaṁ vikopeyya ṭhānā cāveyya saṅketaṁ vītināmeyya.<br><br>Yathārūpaṁ nāma<br><br>pādaṁ vā pādārahaṁ vā atirekapādaṁ vā.<br><br>Rājāno nāma<br><br>pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mahāmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṁ karontā anusāsanti. Ete rājāno nāma.<br><br>Coro nāma<br><br>yo pañcamāsakaṁ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṁ vā agghanakaṁ adinnaṁ theyyasaṅkhātaṁ ādiyati. Eso coro nāma.<br><br>Haneyyuṁ vāti<br><br>hatthena vā pādena vā kasāya vā vettena vā aḍḍhadaṇḍakena vā chejjāya vā haneyyuṁ.<br><br>Bandheyyuṁ vāti<br><br>rajjubandhanena vā andubandhanena vā saṅkhalikabandhanena vā gharabandhanena vā nagarabandhanena vā gāmabandhanena vā nigamabandhanena vā bandheyyuṁ, purisaguttiṁ vā kareyyuṁ.<br><br>Pabbājeyyuṁ vāti<br><br>gāmā vā nigamā vā nagarā vā janapadā vā janapadapadesā vā pabbājeyyuṁ.<br><br>Corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti<br><br>paribhāso eso.<br><br>Tathārūpaṁ nāma<br><br>pādaṁ vā pādārahaṁ vā atirekapādaṁ vā.<br><br>Ādiyamānoti<br><br>ādiyamāno haramāno avaharamāno iriyāpathaṁ vikopayamāno ṭhānā cāvayamāno saṅketaṁ vītināmayamāno.<br><br>Ayampīti<br><br>purimaṁ upādāya vuccati.<br><br>Pārājiko hotīti<br><br>seyyathāpi nāma paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritatthāya;<br><br>evameva bhikkhu pādaṁ vā pādārahaṁ vā atirekapādaṁ vā adinnaṁ theyyasaṅkhātaṁ ādiyitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. Tena vuccati— “pārājiko hotī”ti.<br><br>Asaṁvāsoti<br><br>saṁvāso nāma ekakammaṁ ekuddeso samasikkhatā. Eso saṁvāso nāma.<br><br>So tena saddhiṁ natthi. Tena vuccati—“asaṁvāso”ti.<br><br>Bhūmaṭṭhaṁ thalaṭṭhaṁ ākāsaṭṭhaṁ vehāsaṭṭhaṁ udakaṭṭhaṁ nāvaṭṭhaṁ yānaṭṭhaṁ bhāraṭṭhaṁ ārāmaṭṭhaṁ vihāraṭṭhaṁ khettaṭṭhaṁ vatthuṭṭhaṁ gāmaṭṭhaṁ araññaṭṭhaṁ udakaṁ dantapoṇaṁ vanappati haraṇakaṁ upanidhi suṅkaghātaṁ pāṇo apadaṁ dvipadaṁ catuppadaṁ bahuppadaṁ ocarako oṇirakkho saṁvidāvahāro saṅketakammaṁ nimittakammanti.<br><br>Bhūmaṭṭhaṁ nāma<br><br>bhaṇḍaṁ bhūmiyaṁ nikkhittaṁ hoti nikhātaṁ paṭicchannaṁ.<br><br>Bhūmaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇḍaṁ avaharissāmīti theyyacitto dutiyaṁ vā pariyesati kudālaṁ vā piṭakaṁ vā pariyesati gacchati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Tattha jātakaṁ kaṭṭhaṁ vā lataṁ vā chindati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Tattha paṁsuṁ khaṇati vā byūhati vā uddharati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Kumbhiṁ āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Phandāpeti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Ṭhānā cāveti, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Attano bhājanaṁ pavesetvā pañcamāsakaṁ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṁ vā agghanakaṁ theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Phandāpeti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Attano bhājanagataṁ vā karoti muṭṭhiṁ vā chindati, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Suttāruḷhaṁ bhaṇḍaṁ pāmaṅgaṁ vā kaṇṭhasuttakaṁ vā kaṭisuttakaṁ vā sāṭakaṁ vā veṭhanaṁ vā theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Phandāpeti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Koṭiyaṁ gahetvā uccāreti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Ghaṁsanto nīharati, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Antamaso kesaggamattampi kumbhimukhā moceti, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Sappiṁ vā telaṁ vā madhuṁ vā phāṇitaṁ vā pañcamāsakaṁ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṁ vā agghanakaṁ theyyacitto ekena payogena pivati, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Tattheva bhindati vā chaḍḍeti vā jhāpeti vā aparibhogaṁ vā karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Thalaṭṭhaṁ nāma<br><br>bhaṇḍaṁ thale nikkhittaṁ hoti.<br><br>Thalaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇḍaṁ avaharissāmīti theyyacitto dutiyaṁ vā pariyesati gacchati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Phandāpeti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Ṭhānā cāveti, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Ākāsaṭṭhaṁ nāma<br><br>bhaṇḍaṁ ākāsagataṁ hoti.<br><br>Moro vā kapiñjaro vā tittiro vā vaṭṭako vā, sāṭakaṁ vā veṭhanaṁ vā hiraññaṁ vā suvaṇṇaṁ vā chijjamānaṁ patati.<br><br>Ākāsaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇḍaṁ avaharissāmīti theyyacitto dutiyaṁ vā pariyesati gacchati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Gamanaṁ upacchindati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.<br><br>Phandāpeti, āpatti thullaccayassa.<br><br>Ṭhānā cāveti, āpatti pārājikassa.<br><br>Vehāsaṭṭhaṁ nāma<br><br>bhaṇḍaṁ vehāsagataṁ hoti.<br><br>Mañce vā pīṭhe vā cīvaravaṁse vā cīvararajjuyā vā bhittikhile vā nāgadante vā rukkhe vā laggitaṁ hoti, antamaso pattādhārakepi.<br><br>Vehāsaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇḍaṁ avaharissāmīti theyyacitto dutiyaṁ vā pariyesati
